_comment: The assistant's Q&A sources (portal_assistant/docs/AI_CURRENT_RULES.md section 11, 2026-11-25). Read by the backend (qa_sources.py: faq.py, qna.py, workflow.py), the App's licence page (AssistantDataLicenses) and portal_assistant/scripts/check_qa_source.py. kind: bundled-index (a pre-built e5 index downloaded with the models, models.json; only open-licensed data), runtime-fetch (fetched while the assistant runs from origin + path, kept in memory and a cache outside the repo; its text is never stored in the repo, tests, fixtures or docs), bundled-file (a small Q&A file next to this one, embedded at startup; only text the project may store). origin is 'default' or an origin listed in service_origins.json, never a host written here. Texts in en, ja, vi, id and tl are AI drafts unless noted; the zh texts are the assistant's existing wording. The answer text itself stays in the source's language (Chinese); the App translates a reply for other languages.

freshness._comment: check_qa_source.py lists items whose published_at is more than stale_years old for human review (rules section 11); an answer shows its data date when published_at is known.
